sources.title: GitHub - eth-medical-ai-lab/Med-PRM: [EMNLP 2025] Med-PRM: Medical ...
sources.snippet: MED-PRM is a novel framework designed to enhance clinical decision-making by addressing errors in the reasoning process. It leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to verify each reasoning step against established medical knowledge bases, ensuring accuracy and reliability in medical diagnoses.
